subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of preventive maintenance?

options.text: To eliminate the need for regular inspections
To delay repairs until breakdowns occur
To increase the workload of employees

solution:
The correct answer is __To reduce unexpected equipment failures.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Preventive maintenance__ is a routine maintenance practice aimed at ensuring equipment reliability.
 
• Its primary goal is to reduce unexpected equipment failures by identifying and addressing potential issues early.
 
• It helps in minimizing downtime and increasing the lifespan of equipment.
 
• Preventive maintenance involves scheduled inspections, servicing, and regular checks.
 
• It is a proactive approach to maintain operational efficiency and safety.
 
• Examples of preventive maintenance include lubrication, cleaning, and replacing parts before failure.
 
• Implementing preventive maintenance can reduce repair costs and improve productivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Corrective Maintenance:**

 
 
• It is performed after equipment failure to restore it to working order.
 
• Corrective maintenance is reactive and often more costly than preventive maintenance.
 
 
 
• **Predictive Maintenance: **
 
 
• It uses data analysis tools and techniques to detect potential issues in advance.
 
• Predictive maintenance relies on condition-monitoring technologies to predict equipment failure.
 
 
 
• **Maintenance Management Systems:**
 
 
• These systems help organizations plan, schedule, and track maintenance activities.
 
• They improve efficiency by ensuring timely maintenance and resource allocation.
